stories.title: Syria weighs sending troops to help Saudis fight Houthis
stories.description: U.S. officials say Riyadh asked for Syrian forces as a Saudi-backed offensive against Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis makes limited gains.

stories.title: Russian strikes kill at least 25 in Ukraine, 19 in Pryluky
stories.description: Zelenskiy called it one of Russia's most "vile strikes," noting the barrage of 70 missiles and drones fell on Putin's birthday.

stories.title: Rubio denies US is blocking Machado's return to Venezuela
stories.description: In Athens, Rubio rejected a Wall Street Journal report while the Nobel laureate vows to return after repeated blocked attempts.

stories.title: Gaza death toll tops 74,000 as war hits three-year mark
stories.description: Gaza's Health Ministry says 1,462 were killed after the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, and UN data shows many households living in tents.

stories.title: Ukraine's Vivaldi offensive derails Russian Donbas push
stories.description: Finland's Black Bird Group says September was Russia's worst month for net territorial losses since June 2023, contradicting Putin's claims of inevitable conquest.

stories.title: Kremlin says no Trump call agreed on Siberia plague death
stories.description: Trump said Tuesday he would discuss a Russian lab worker's suspected pneumonic plague death with Putin. Russia hasn't confirmed plague caused it.

stories.title: Kagan, Soai win Nobel chemistry prize for mirror molecules
stories.description: The French and Japanese chemists were honored for explaining how one mirror-image form can dominate, work the academy calls decisive for drugmaking.

stories.title: Putin adds $60B to war budget as talks stall, report says
stories.description: Bloomberg's sources say Russia's 2026 defense spending will reach nearly 17 trillion rubles, about 40% above plan, after Putin decided US-brokered talks had failed.

stories.title: Israel marks 3 years since Oct. 7 attack, weeks before vote
stories.description: Survivors and bereaved families led dawn ceremonies at the Nova festival site, the first anniversary since the ceasefire with all hostages returned.

stories.title: Tanker attack in Hormuz injures 12 crew, India says
stories.description: The strike on the Panama-flagged On Peace comes as Iran steps up ship attacks even as Gulf oil exports near prewar levels.

stories.title: UK police arrest seventh suspect in RAF Fairford probe
stories.description: A 22-year-old British man was held in Westminster on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts, while six earlier suspects remain on bail.

stories.title: Paramount closes $110B Warner Bros. deal to form Skydance
stories.description: CEO David Ellison now controls Paramount, Warner Bros., CBS, CNN and HBO Max as the combined company's shares begin trading under SKYD.

stories.title: Large fire engulfs oil tanker off Russia's Sochi coast
stories.description: Some media reports point to a possible drone attack. Russian authorities have not given a cause or said whether anyone was hurt.

stories.title: France test-fires new nuclear missile as Macron watches
stories.description: The unarmed M51.3 was launched from the submarine Le Vigilant off Brittany. Macron called the test proof of France's deterrent amid Russia tensions.

stories.title: Rubio assures Iceland US has no designs on the island
stories.description: Opening a NATO tour, the secretary of state said Washington is open to a bigger military role, but only with Iceland's consent.

stories.title: Francis Halzen wins physics Nobel for cosmic neutrino find
stories.description: The University of Wisconsin–Madison physicist leads IceCube, a South Pole detector that first spotted high-energy neutrinos arriving from beyond our galaxy.

stories.title: Germany arrests ex-spy chief Hanning in espionage probe
stories.description: Prosecutors allege August Hanning, who led the BND spy agency until 2005, passed political information to another country's intelligence service.

stories.title: Lithuania offers to pay for US base as Trump weighs idea
stories.description: Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius said Vilnius will cover costs if Washington decides to station troops permanently, though officials say no decision exists yet.

stories.title: Brazil's Federal Police probe alleged US election meddling
stories.description: Inquiry targets a reported $1 million US grant for Supreme Court critics as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro head to a runoff.

stories.title: Ukraine says strikes knocked out half of Russia's refining
stories.description: The unverified claim came as Russia's Defense Ministry vowed to intensify strikes on Kyiv after Zelenskyy pledged more refinery attacks.

stories.title: UAE shared FlyDubai crew list with Israel, officials say
stories.description: Israel flagged no one aboard, though the Omani co-pilot was barred from flying at home, sparking blame between Shin Bet and Transportation Ministry.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tops Lula in first round, forcing runoff
stories.description: The senator's surprise first-place finish defied polls showing Lula ahead and sets up an Oct. 25 runoff amid a broader rightward shift.

stories.title: Merz pledges €1.3 billion to Ukraine in surprise Kyiv trip
stories.description: Funding targets interceptors for Russia's jet drones and Ukraine's power grid, as a Russian drone hit a Kyiv bridge during the visit.

stories.title: UK Green Party adopt motion defining Zionism as racism
stories.description: Members at the Brighton conference backed the motion 1,022 to 813 and rejected amendments from leader Zack Polanski, who did not vote.

stories.title: Flydubai suspect probably acted alone, Israeli sources say
stories.description: One Israeli source said no link to any group or government is known, though Netanyahu cited "Islamist radical indoctrination."

stories.title: Russia hits Kyiv bridge again as Merz visits capital
stories.description: Drones hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge on a fourth day of attacks that have partly or fully closed half the city's road bridges.

stories.title: US Marine arrested in Okinawa killing; Takaichi protests
stories.description: Police say the Futenma-based Marine, who denies wrongdoing, is suspected of killing a woman in a Naha hotel and robbing her.

stories.title: Saudi-backed Yemen government launches offensive on Houthis
stories.description: President Rashad al-Alimi vowed to retake all rebel-held territory after the Houthis claimed a strike on a Saudi Aramco site in Riyadh.

stories.title: Trump weighs Iran decision: 'easy way or hard way'
stories.description: Trump spoke Saturday as another carrier group and thousands more US troops head to the Middle East while talks with Tehran stall.

stories.title: Two Iranian men charged over Manchester Yom Kippur plot
stories.description: Police allege the pair held bomb-making components and scouted targets; charges came on the anniversary of the Heaton Park synagogue attack.

stories.title: Kim oversees hypersonic missile test, claims 1,000-km range
stories.description: North Korea's 1,000-km claim beats Seoul's estimate of more than 700 km, as tensions rise over a DMZ landmine blast that wounded South Korean soldiers.

stories.title: Trump says Iran has 'virtually given up' nuclear weapons
stories.description: Trump offered no evidence as Iran keeps blocking U.N. nuclear inspections, with a lawmaker saying cooperation hinges on security guarantees.

stories.title: Oman grounded FlyDubai co-pilot over radical views
stories.description: Sources say FlyDubai later hired him to fly the UAE-Israel route, where he allegedly stabbed his captain and sent Flight 1073 diving.

stories.title: France shuts 400 schools as student protests turn violent
stories.description: Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin says about 2,000 people have been arrested as clashes continue. Education Minister Édouard Geffray meets unions, parents Friday.

stories.title: Vance led secret Camp David talks on Iran war, Houthis
stories.description: Trump's top security aides met for hours Friday as Iran talks stall and Trump weighs resuming major combat operations, Axios reports.

stories.title: Putin vows to take rest of Donetsk sooner than expected
stories.description: At the Valdai forum, Putin claimed Russia seized 1,301 square kilometers in September, but AFP analysis of ISW data shows Ukraine gained ground.

stories.title: Germany pledges help as Burnham floats rejoining EU
stories.description: Ambassador Susanne Baumann's pledge follows Macron's "welcome back," while Brussels awaits concrete proposals and Farage vows to fight.

stories.title: Trump rules out diesel export ban after G7 fuel release
stories.description: G7 leaders agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel over four months, frontloading diesel as U.S. prices near records.

stories.title: Carney names Pacific oil pipeline first national interest project
stories.description: The million-barrel-a-day oil pipeline to Delta, B.C., moves to a faster federal review, with Ottawa aiming to finalize conditions by Sept. 1, 2027.

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine used own ballistic missile in combat
stories.description: Zelensky didn't disclose the target of the Fire Point-made FP-7, a hard-to-intercept weapon, and said scaling up production comes next.

stories.title: Iran denies offering inspector access for sanctions relief
stories.description: Bloomberg reported Foreign Minister Araghchi privately floated restoring inspectors' access to bombed sites, but IRNA called the report "absolutely false."

stories.title: US sends third carrier, up to 10,000 troops to Middle East
stories.description: The buildup, due by late November, comes as Trump weighs resuming strikes on Iran after the midterms, officials told the Journal.

stories.title: Putin rejects strike truce, says Russia lost 1% of GDP
stories.description: Putin called a U.S.-backed proposal to mutually halt refinery and ship attacks "ridiculous" and said Kyiv's strikes had partly succeeded.

stories.title: Anthropic targets IPO before Thanksgiving, Bloomberg says
stories.description: The Claude maker could start formal marketing as soon as the week of Nov. 9 after pushing back earlier listing plans.

stories.title: Rubio ordered Iran's UN team out, U.S. official says
stories.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's delegation flew to Doha early Tuesday after U.S.-Iran talks stalled, a rare diplomatic rebuke.

stories.title: Huang, other CEOs confronted Amodei over AI warnings at White House
stories.description: Behind the scenes of Tuesday's voluntary AI safety accord, tech executives challenged Anthropic's chief over his calls to slow development.

stories.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon to reclaim AI frontier
stories.description: The new flagship model claims to outperform OpenAI and Anthropic rivals on coding and cybersecurity benchmarks after months of delays.

stories.title: Russia calls European arms factories for Ukraine legitimate military targets
stories.description: Moscow's foreign ministry spokeswoman said factories producing weapons for Kyiv "will not be safe," escalating threats against NATO members.

stories.title: US completes troop withdrawal from Iraq after two decades
stories.description: The final American forces depart Wednesday, ending Operation Inherent Resolve and over 20 years of military involvement in the country.

stories.title: Anthropic warns Z.ai's GLM-5.3 AI can build cyber exploits without safeguards
stories.description: The company says the open-weight model from Zhipu AI matches its own Claude Mythos Preview in exploit capability but lacks meaningful protections against misuse.

stories.title: Supreme Court lets Trump resume third-country deportations
stories.description: The justices lifted a lower-court block on deporting migrants to countries not listed in their removal orders and will hear full arguments in December.

stories.title: OpenAI unveils Dots, an always-on AI agent, at DevDay 2026
stories.description: Powered by GPT-6 Astra, each Dot gets its own cloud computer and can connect to over 4,000 apps to handle tasks around the clock.

stories.title: Myanmar airstrike on crowded Rakhine market kills at least 50
stories.description: Rescuers found more bodies Tuesday after a military jet bombed a wholesale market and bridge in Kyauktaw, wounding 58 others.

stories.title: EU vows to push global AI safety rules despite Trump opposition
stories.description: Commissioner Virkkunen said Brussels will keep pursuing international AI regulations after Trump rejected any "globalist scheme" at the UN.

stories.title: NATO denounces Russia's nuclear threat over Kaliningrad
stories.description: Moscow warned it would use "the entire arsenal" including nuclear weapons to defend the Baltic exclave from any NATO isolation attempt.

stories.title: OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra over deception, safety failures
stories.description: The next-gen model, due in October for ChatGPT and Codex, showed deceptive behavior and acted without user permission during internal testing.

stories.title: U.S. and China release $60 billion tariff cut lists
stories.description: The "30-for-30" deal covers American agriculture and Chinese consumer goods but excludes strategic sectors like chips and EVs.

stories.title: NATO scrambles jets after mystery object detected near Romania-Ukraine border
stories.description: Russia fired 152 drones and three missiles at Ukraine overnight as an unidentified aerial target triggered NATO's air policing response along the Danube.

stories.title: AMD to buy Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion
stories.description: The all-stock deal brings spatial-intelligence AI research in-house as AMD seeks to close the gap with Nvidia in next-generation AI ecosystems.

stories.title: Six killed, including 4 Americans, in Athens gas explosion near the Acropolis
stories.description: Rescue crews recovered all six bodies Saturday from a building destroyed Friday by a suspected gas blast in the historic Plaka tourist district.

stories.title: Trump tells Zelenskyy to 'settle with Putin' as strikes kill at least 16
stories.description: At the UN General Assembly, Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov accused Europe of blocking peace talks as both sides traded deadly aerial attacks Saturday.

stories.title: OpenAI halts AI training after agent escapes sandbox a second time
stories.description: The company says an AI agent exploited a DNS filtering gap on Sept. 20 to reach the internet from a locked-down testing environment.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan activate defense pact amid Houthi barrage
stories.description: The three nations' foreign ministers met Thursday and announced an urgent chiefs-of-staff meeting as the Houthis fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi targets.

stories.title: Trump administration locks in $400M Ukraine aid before deadline
stories.description: Sources say $307 million has been obligated, with the remaining $93 million set to be committed before the fiscal year ends Sept. 30.

stories.title: OpenAI notifies dozens of agencies after AI models breached external sites
stories.description: The company says "misaligned" models bypassed security controls at government agencies and universities during internal testing, prompting an expanding probe.

stories.title: Zelensky says Russia's territorial demands dropped from peace talks
stories.description: Speaking in New York, Ukraine's president credited battlefield gains for pushing the "Anchorage agreements" off the negotiating agenda.

stories.title: Xi urges Trump to formally oppose Taiwan independence
stories.description: Beijing's demand marks a deliberate escalation from Washington's longstanding stance that it "does not support" Taiwan's formal independence.

stories.title: Scores of delegates walk out as Netanyahu addresses UN General Assembly
stories.description: The Israeli prime minister delivered a defiant speech to a mostly empty hall, calling departing diplomats "moral cowards."

stories.title: Carney confirms Canada will move away from Starlink, F-35s
stories.description: Canada's prime minister told The New York Times his government plans to reduce reliance on U.S. defense and technology systems.

stories.title: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic name joint AI safety body
stories.description: The Standards Authority for Frontier AI is the tentative name for the new organization, according to The Information.

stories.title: Macron to send troops and radars to protect Saudi oil port from Houthis
stories.description: France will deploy soldiers and defense systems to Yanbu, a critical Red Sea terminal for Saudi crude exports under Houthi attack.

stories.title: Carney says he prepared for risk of U.S. military action against Canada
stories.description: In a New York Times interview, the Canadian prime minister called it "extreme tail risk" that would be "irresponsible" to ignore amid an escalating trade war.

stories.title: Carney says Canada won't trade away EU ties for U.S. deal
stories.description: At the UN General Assembly, the prime minister said a deal with Washington is possible but Canada's right to deepen global partnerships is non-negotiable.

stories.title: Abbas calls US visa ban 'punitive' in virtual UN speech
stories.description: The Palestinian Authority president addressed the General Assembly from Ramallah after being barred from entering the U.S. for a second straight year.

stories.title: China seized diverted F-35 stealth parts, Bloomberg reports
stories.description: Stealth-coated components shipped from Australia via UPS were rerouted to Hong Kong in late May, prompting a Pentagon investigation and congressional briefings.

stories.title: Altman, Amodei urge AI caution at UN Security Council
stories.description: The OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs called for international cooperation on AI safety, a day after Trump rejected global oversight as a "globalist scheme."

stories.title: Zelenskyy urges UN to choke Russia's war revenues
stories.description: Speaking at the General Assembly, Zelenskyy called Putin "Patient Zero" and said Ukraine is ready for an energy ceasefire with Moscow.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian calls country a 'victim' in rare wartime UN address
stories.description: Speaking a day after Trump threatened to "annihilate" Iran, the Iranian president defended Tehran's actions and warned against using the Strait of Hormuz for aggression.

stories.title: Tigray declares 'defensive war' as forces seize airport, clash with federal troops
stories.description: Fighting spread to the Afar region as the TPLF seized Mekelle's airport and Ethiopian Airlines suspended all flights to Tigray.

stories.title: Rubio says US invited Putin to G20 summit in Miami
stories.description: The announcement followed a closed-door meeting between Rubio and Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov at the UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Trump holds first meeting with US-backed Venezuelan leader at UN
stories.description: The talks with interim President Delcy Rodríguez took place near the New York jail where ousted leader Nicolás Maduro awaits trial.

stories.title: UK and France warn of escalating Russian hybrid warfare threat
stories.description: European leaders are issuing urgent warnings about Russia's expanding campaign of sabotage, cyberattacks, and military provocations across the continent.

stories.title: North Korea tests new hypersonic missile as Kim warns of 'incurable headache' for enemies
stories.description: Kim Jong Un oversaw the launch of two short-range ballistic missiles on Sept. 20, the country's 14th ballistic missile test this year.

stories.title: US and Iran hold first direct talks in months at UN General Assembly
stories.description: Trump said envoys Witkoff and Kushner had a "very good" three-hour meeting with Iranian officials, with another session planned soon.

stories.title: AMD surpasses $1 trillion market cap for first time on AI demand
stories.description: Shares surged to a record high Monday as investors bet on the chipmaker's expanding role in AI computing, particularly for CPU-heavy agent workloads.

stories.title: Putin's United Russia retains parliament majority in tightly controlled vote
stories.description: Preliminary results show the ruling party winning roughly 355 of 450 Duma seats after a three-day election that sidelined opposition candidates.

stories.title: Macron rebukes Trump on Gaza in farewell UN speech
stories.description: The French president called Trump's claimed peace a "spectacle that should shame us all," saying humanitarian access has not resumed.

stories.title: AfD wins second German state as Merz vows to stay on
stories.description: Exit polls show the far-right party took Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania with 37%, while Merz's CDU slumped to a historic low of 5.5%.

stories.title: Iran threatens 'painful' strikes on U.S. bases across Mideast
stories.description: Tehran's military command claims intelligence of planned U.S. strikes, while senior officials signal willingness to revive collapsed June framework deal.

stories.title: Trump tells UN that AI will now be called 'super intelligence'
stories.description: The president said U.S. government documents would replace "artificial intelligence" with "super intelligence," calling the term more accurate.

stories.title: Carney and Macron pledge joint space, defense work at symbolic island summit
stories.description: Meeting on French territory off Canada's coast, the leaders tasked their agencies to co-develop space launch systems amid strained U.S. ties.

stories.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport after overnight air-raid alerts
stories.description: Flightradar24 placed King Khalid International Airport at its maximum disruption index as flights were delayed and canceled Saturday.

stories.title: Trump signs Greenland security deal with Denmark at U.N.
stories.description: The trilateral agreement permits two new U.S. military bases and a missile defense system on the Arctic island while reaffirming Danish sovereignty.

stories.title: Google says Gemini autonomously hacked three firms during cybersecurity test
stories.description: Google is the fourth major AI lab to disclose that its models broke loose during security evaluations conducted by the same testing firm, Irregular.

stories.title: AI-generated false report nearly triggered US-China military clash, CNN reports
stories.description: An AI chatbot wrongly identified a Chinese ship's cargo as nuclear weapons components, prompting armed personnel and aircraft to mobilize before the error was caught.

stories.title: Trump defends Iran war in address to UN General Assembly
stories.description: The president accused Tehran of stalling negotiations until after the midterms and dismissed domestic political concerns over the nearly seven-month conflict.

stories.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chairman
stories.description: The 96-year-old investor named his son Howard as his successor and will stay on the board as chairman emeritus.

stories.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 31-year high of 1.25%
stories.description: The widely expected hike, the sixth since March 2024, came amid rising inflation, a weak yen, and growing pressure from Washington.

stories.title: Xi Jinping health rumors swirl after early BRICS departure
stories.description: China and India have pushed back on unverified claims that Xi fell ill at the New Delhi summit, as attention turns to a planned meeting with Trump.

stories.title: South Korea's Lee rules out combat role in Middle East
stories.description: The president said Seoul would not deploy troops to join the Iran war but is weighing limited measures to protect shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping 'largest theft' in history
stories.description: Unredacted filings in the New York Times' copyright suit show executives at both companies privately acknowledged AI training harmed publishers.

stories.title: Cook, Altman, Huang to attend Trump-Xi state dinner
stories.description: Top AI and tech leaders will join President Trump's White House state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping next week amid tensions over AI regulation and trade.

stories.title: First new wild cat species in a century found in Bolivia
stories.description: Researchers formally described the tilcayo, a small spotted cat from Bolivia's cloud forests, in a study that also splits tiger cats into five species.

stories.title: Russia, China veto UN panel monitoring Iran sanctions
stories.description: The panel's mandate expires Sept. 27, leaving no functioning body to oversee compliance with reimposed nuclear sanctions on Tehran.

stories.title: Carney welcomes EU associate membership bid despite Trump threats
stories.description: Canada's PM told the European Parliament the alliance would ensure "no one can control our open markets" or "undermine our freedoms."

stories.title: UN mission says US strikes on Iran school constitute war crimes
stories.description: The report also found Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity during a crackdown on anti-government protests.

stories.title: China presses Iran to rein in Houthis after Saudi appeal
stories.description: Beijing privately urged Tehran to curb the Houthis as their two-week offensive reshapes Yemen's Red Sea coast and threatens global energy routes.

stories.title: Russian drone found on Polish beach carried live warhead, prosecutors confirm
stories.description: Poland also scrambled jets and closed two airports Wednesday after fresh Russian drone strikes targeted western Ukraine near the border.

stories.title: Kosovo ex-President Thaci sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
stories.description: The Hague tribunal convicted Thaci and three other former KLA commanders of murder, torture and arbitrary detention during the 1998-99 war.

stories.title: US held secret talks with Houthis in Oman after Red Sea seizure
stories.description: The previously undisclosed Sunday meeting at the U.S. Embassy in Muscat came days after the Houthis captured Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline.

stories.title: Apple explores return to server market with Nvidia tech
stories.description: CEO John Ternus is backing a plan to sell AI servers powered by M8 Ultra chips, targeting a 2029 launch, according to The Information.

stories.title: Lavrov says Russia ready for Ukraine talks but firm on keeping NATO from its borders
stories.description: Moscow is open to bilateral and trilateral negotiations and plans to meet Rubio at the U.N. General Assembly later this month.

stories.title: Von der Leyen to invite AI labs for slowdown talks
stories.description: The EU chief also unveiled the EU Kids Act, which would ban social media for children under 13 across the 27-member bloc.

stories.title: China calls for UN-led AI governance after dismissing US slowdown push
stories.description: Beijing shifted from denouncing Silicon Valley's AI warnings as "fearmongering" to urging multilateral cooperation, ahead of a planned Xi-Trump meeting.

stories.title: Von der Leyen decries Russian 'aggression' after dual NATO incidents
stories.description: A Russian frigate fired flares at a Danish helicopter Monday, and NATO jets shot down a drone over Lithuania hours later.

stories.title: Germany rejects AI pause, calls for U.S.-China oversight
stories.description: Berlin said halting AI development is not viable for Europe, even as Anthropic's CEO urged the industry to slow capability gains.

stories.title: China's spy chief names U.S. AI models as threats to national security
stories.description: State Security Minister Chen Yixin singled out Anthropic's Claude Mythos and OpenAI's ChatGPT-5.5-Cyber as risks to critical infrastructure ahead of Trump-Xi talks.

stories.title: Modi warns against weaponizing critical minerals at BRICS summit in New Delhi
stories.description: Without naming China directly, the PM called for inclusive technology adoption as the bloc wrapped up its two-day summit.

stories.title: Russian drone hits train 2 km from Polish border after Johnson passes through
stories.description: A jet-propelled drone struck a Kyiv-to-Warsaw passenger train at Yahodyn, shortly after Boris Johnson and European officials used the same route.

stories.title: Putin rejects energy ceasefire before winter, FT reports
stories.description: The Kremlin believes continued strikes on Ukraine's energy grid will force Kyiv into concessions as cold weather approaches, despite Trump claiming a deal was reached.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI slowdown after report exposes Claude misuse
stories.description: Dario Amodei's Saturday essay followed a threat report detailing how adversaries used Claude for autonomous drones, surveillance and bioweapons research.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian says US failed to topple Tehran, vows not to surrender
stories.description: Speaking in New Delhi ahead of the BRICS summit, the Iranian president accused Washington of blocking food and medicine and called its campaign "the most savage thing."

stories.title: Trump says he'll remove 15% tariff on Irish whiskey
stories.description: The president made the announcement during the prizegiving ceremony at the Amgen Irish Open, held at his Doonbeg golf resort.

stories.title: U.S. links Chinese satellite imagery to Iran strike that killed 3 troops
stories.description: Officials say the finding is the most definitive proof to date that Chinese assistance to Iran has led to American casualties.

stories.title: Anthropic says Iran-linked actors used Claude AI to target US Navy ships
stories.description: A 154-page threat report details how operatives compiled targeting handbooks on warships, tracked personnel and researched shipboard vulnerabilities.

stories.title: Putin slams West's 'ugly' tactics at BRICS forum in New Delhi
stories.description: Modi and Putin led calls for deeper economic ties as the expanded bloc convened ahead of Saturday's leaders' summit.

stories.title: Africa accounts for two-thirds of ISIS activity, US panel warns on 9/11 anniversary
stories.description: A House Homeland Security Committee report finds seven of the 10 countries with the most terrorism deaths are in Africa.

stories.title: Canada and Ukraine sign 100-year partnership deal
stories.description: The agreement, signed Thursday in Calgary, includes a $350 million air defense package and plans to jointly produce millions of drones.

stories.title: Iran restarts ballistic missile production underground
stories.description: Tehran is assembling both liquid- and solid-fueled missiles from prewar stockpiles at subterranean sites, according to The Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: ECB raises interest rates to 2.50% amid Middle East inflation pressures
stories.description: The Governing Council lifted the deposit rate by 25 basis points in what economists say is the ECB's shortest hiking cycle in 15 years.

stories.title: Zelensky's plane nearly hit by Russian drone over Moldova, Norway's PM says
stories.description: A suspected Shahed-type drone came close to striking the Ukrainian president's aircraft as it departed Moldova for King Harald V's funeral in Oslo.

stories.title: Tate brothers denied bail in Miami extradition fight
stories.description: A federal judge ruled Andrew and Tristan Tate are flight risks and must remain jailed while contesting extradition to the U.K. on 59 sex crime charges.

stories.title: Russia rehearsed wars against NATO in secret simulations since 2017, investigation finds
stories.description: The Dossier Center uncovered exercises at a Moscow military academy involving scenarios targeting Gotland, Japan, and Ukraine.

stories.title: Ukraine reveals €23B defense budget gap at Ramstein talks
stories.description: Defense Minister Khmara urged allies to commit funds by November to sustain drone production through winter as the U.S. warned of a protracted war.

stories.title: Trump bans Canadian dairy, alcohol, vehicle imports starting Sept. 29
stories.description: The president escalated the trade war beyond tariffs to outright import prohibitions as Canada's retaliatory duties on American goods took effect Tuesday.

stories.title: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent that acts on users' behalf
stories.description: The free agent can send emails, book travel, and make purchases autonomously, with paid tiers at $20 and $100 per month.

stories.title: Argentina files criminal charges against Israeli oil firm over Falklands drilling
stories.description: The complaint targets Navitas Petroleum subsidiaries and executives for operating without Argentine authorization in the disputed territory.

stories.title: Iran declares preemptive strike doctrine with new missile
stories.description: Tehran says the Qassem Basir ballistic missile signals it will act against threats before they materialize, escalating its six-month war with the U.S.

stories.title: Thousands attend Mladic funeral in Belgrade despite EU criticism
stories.description: Serbia buried the convicted war criminal with military honors as EU officials condemned the public glorification of the former Bosnian Serb commander.

stories.title: Witkoff, Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Putin meeting yields no breakthrough
stories.description: The U.S. envoys met Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after three-plus hours with Putin in Moscow, as Washington revives its push to end the war in Ukraine.

stories.title: Russia threatens to target US missile sites in Norway
stories.description: Moscow warned that US launch sites and command centers deployed to Norway would become targets in any military conflict.

stories.title: Huckabee calls violent Israeli settlers 'terrorists' during West Bank visit
stories.description: The U.S. ambassador to Israel visited Turmus Ayya on Saturday, urging "severe consequences" for settlers attacking Palestinian Americans.

stories.title: Trump calls Iran conflict 'small potatoes,' backs Vance's rejection of 'war' label
stories.description: The president described six months of U.S. strikes on Iran as a "military conflict," not a war, as midterm elections approach.

stories.title: France, Poland warn AfD landslide threatens NATO corridor
stories.description: Polish FM Sikorski says the AfD's 44% win in Saxony-Anhalt could slow allied troop movements through a key transit state to NATO's eastern flank.

stories.title: UN votes 164-1 to promote maps showing Africa's true size
stories.description: The General Assembly endorsed a resolution encouraging adoption of Equal Earth and other equal-area projections over the 16th-century Mercator map.

stories.title: DOJ antitrust division halts cooperation with Canada
stories.description: The directive, reported by The Wall Street Journal, opens a new front in the escalating U.S.-Canada trade war.

stories.title: China warns G20 row could threaten Xi-Trump summit
stories.description: Beijing says U.S. accusations over a blocked G20 communiqué risk damaging relations ahead of Xi Jinping's Sept. 24 White House visit.

stories.title: Denmark says Russia is planning sabotage against its defense industry
stories.description: PET revealed that Russian intelligence is recruiting Danes to scout defense firms linked to Ukraine aid, citing arson as a possible objective.

stories.title: Argentina's Milei declares Falklands 'Argentinean,' sanctions oil firms
stories.description: The address came hours after Trump hinted the U.S. would not back Britain over the islands, citing the UK's refusal to join the Iran campaign.

stories.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra, declares 'AGI era'
stories.description: The company's most powerful model yet can autonomously operate software and exploit cybersecurity flaws, raising sharp safety concerns.

top.title: Syria weighs sending troops to help Saudis fight Houthis
top.description: U.S. officials say Riyadh asked for Syrian forces as a Saudi-backed offensive against Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis makes limited gains.

top.title: Russian strikes kill at least 25 in Ukraine, 19 in Pryluky
top.description: Zelenskiy called it one of Russia's most "vile strikes," noting the barrage of 70 missiles and drones fell on Putin's birthday.

top.title: Rubio denies US is blocking Machado's return to Venezuela
top.description: In Athens, Rubio rejected a Wall Street Journal report while the Nobel laureate vows to return after repeated blocked attempts.

top.title: Gaza death toll tops 74,000 as war hits three-year mark
top.description: Gaza's Health Ministry says 1,462 were killed after the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, and UN data shows many households living in tents.

top.title: Ukraine's Vivaldi offensive derails Russian Donbas push
top.description: Finland's Black Bird Group says September was Russia's worst month for net territorial losses since June 2023, contradicting Putin's claims of inevitable conquest.

top.title: Kremlin says no Trump call agreed on Siberia plague death
top.description: Trump said Tuesday he would discuss a Russian lab worker's suspected pneumonic plague death with Putin. Russia hasn't confirmed plague caused it.

top.title: Kagan, Soai win Nobel chemistry prize for mirror molecules
top.description: The French and Japanese chemists were honored for explaining how one mirror-image form can dominate, work the academy calls decisive for drugmaking.

top.title: Putin adds $60B to war budget as talks stall, report says
top.description: Bloomberg's sources say Russia's 2026 defense spending will reach nearly 17 trillion rubles, about 40% above plan, after Putin decided US-brokered talks had failed.

top.title: Israel marks 3 years since Oct. 7 attack, weeks before vote
top.description: Survivors and bereaved families led dawn ceremonies at the Nova festival site, the first anniversary since the ceasefire with all hostages returned.

top.title: Tanker attack in Hormuz injures 12 crew, India says
top.description: The strike on the Panama-flagged On Peace comes as Iran steps up ship attacks even as Gulf oil exports near prewar levels.

top.title: UK police arrest seventh suspect in RAF Fairford probe
top.description: A 22-year-old British man was held in Westminster on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts, while six earlier suspects remain on bail.

top.title: Paramount closes $110B Warner Bros. deal to form Skydance
top.description: CEO David Ellison now controls Paramount, Warner Bros., CBS, CNN and HBO Max as the combined company's shares begin trading under SKYD.

top.title: Large fire engulfs oil tanker off Russia's Sochi coast
top.description: Some media reports point to a possible drone attack. Russian authorities have not given a cause or said whether anyone was hurt.

top.title: France test-fires new nuclear missile as Macron watches
top.description: The unarmed M51.3 was launched from the submarine Le Vigilant off Brittany. Macron called the test proof of France's deterrent amid Russia tensions.

top.title: Rubio assures Iceland US has no designs on the island
top.description: Opening a NATO tour, the secretary of state said Washington is open to a bigger military role, but only with Iceland's consent.

top.title: Francis Halzen wins physics Nobel for cosmic neutrino find
top.description: The University of Wisconsin–Madison physicist leads IceCube, a South Pole detector that first spotted high-energy neutrinos arriving from beyond our galaxy.

top.title: Germany arrests ex-spy chief Hanning in espionage probe
top.description: Prosecutors allege August Hanning, who led the BND spy agency until 2005, passed political information to another country's intelligence service.

top.title: Lithuania offers to pay for US base as Trump weighs idea
top.description: Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius said Vilnius will cover costs if Washington decides to station troops permanently, though officials say no decision exists yet.

top.title: Brazil's Federal Police probe alleged US election meddling
top.description: Inquiry targets a reported $1 million US grant for Supreme Court critics as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro head to a runoff.

top.title: Ukraine says strikes knocked out half of Russia's refining
top.description: The unverified claim came as Russia's Defense Ministry vowed to intensify strikes on Kyiv after Zelenskyy pledged more refinery attacks.

top.title: UAE shared FlyDubai crew list with Israel, officials say
top.description: Israel flagged no one aboard, though the Omani co-pilot was barred from flying at home, sparking blame between Shin Bet and Transportation Ministry.

top.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tops Lula in first round, forcing runoff
top.description: The senator's surprise first-place finish defied polls showing Lula ahead and sets up an Oct. 25 runoff amid a broader rightward shift.

top.title: Merz pledges €1.3 billion to Ukraine in surprise Kyiv trip
top.description: Funding targets interceptors for Russia's jet drones and Ukraine's power grid, as a Russian drone hit a Kyiv bridge during the visit.

top.title: UK Green Party adopt motion defining Zionism as racism
top.description: Members at the Brighton conference backed the motion 1,022 to 813 and rejected amendments from leader Zack Polanski, who did not vote.

top.title: Flydubai suspect probably acted alone, Israeli sources say
top.description: One Israeli source said no link to any group or government is known, though Netanyahu cited "Islamist radical indoctrination."

top.title: Russia hits Kyiv bridge again as Merz visits capital
top.description: Drones hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge on a fourth day of attacks that have partly or fully closed half the city's road bridges.

top.title: US Marine arrested in Okinawa killing; Takaichi protests
top.description: Police say the Futenma-based Marine, who denies wrongdoing, is suspected of killing a woman in a Naha hotel and robbing her.

top.title: Saudi-backed Yemen government launches offensive on Houthis
top.description: President Rashad al-Alimi vowed to retake all rebel-held territory after the Houthis claimed a strike on a Saudi Aramco site in Riyadh.

top.title: Trump weighs Iran decision: 'easy way or hard way'
top.description: Trump spoke Saturday as another carrier group and thousands more US troops head to the Middle East while talks with Tehran stall.

top.title: Two Iranian men charged over Manchester Yom Kippur plot
top.description: Police allege the pair held bomb-making components and scouted targets; charges came on the anniversary of the Heaton Park synagogue attack.

top.title: Kim oversees hypersonic missile test, claims 1,000-km range
top.description: North Korea's 1,000-km claim beats Seoul's estimate of more than 700 km, as tensions rise over a DMZ landmine blast that wounded South Korean soldiers.

top.title: Trump says Iran has 'virtually given up' nuclear weapons
top.description: Trump offered no evidence as Iran keeps blocking U.N. nuclear inspections, with a lawmaker saying cooperation hinges on security guarantees.

top.title: Oman grounded FlyDubai co-pilot over radical views
top.description: Sources say FlyDubai later hired him to fly the UAE-Israel route, where he allegedly stabbed his captain and sent Flight 1073 diving.

top.title: France shuts 400 schools as student protests turn violent
top.description: Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin says about 2,000 people have been arrested as clashes continue. Education Minister Édouard Geffray meets unions, parents Friday.

top.title: Vance led secret Camp David talks on Iran war, Houthis
top.description: Trump's top security aides met for hours Friday as Iran talks stall and Trump weighs resuming major combat operations, Axios reports.

top.title: Putin vows to take rest of Donetsk sooner than expected
top.description: At the Valdai forum, Putin claimed Russia seized 1,301 square kilometers in September, but AFP analysis of ISW data shows Ukraine gained ground.

top.title: Germany pledges help as Burnham floats rejoining EU
top.description: Ambassador Susanne Baumann's pledge follows Macron's "welcome back," while Brussels awaits concrete proposals and Farage vows to fight.

top.title: Trump rules out diesel export ban after G7 fuel release
top.description: G7 leaders agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel over four months, frontloading diesel as U.S. prices near records.

top.title: Carney names Pacific oil pipeline first national interest project
top.description: The million-barrel-a-day oil pipeline to Delta, B.C., moves to a faster federal review, with Ottawa aiming to finalize conditions by Sept. 1, 2027.

top.title: Zelensky says Ukraine used own ballistic missile in combat
top.description: Zelensky didn't disclose the target of the Fire Point-made FP-7, a hard-to-intercept weapon, and said scaling up production comes next.

top.title: Iran denies offering inspector access for sanctions relief
top.description: Bloomberg reported Foreign Minister Araghchi privately floated restoring inspectors' access to bombed sites, but IRNA called the report "absolutely false."

top.title: US sends third carrier, up to 10,000 troops to Middle East
top.description: The buildup, due by late November, comes as Trump weighs resuming strikes on Iran after the midterms, officials told the Journal.

top.title: Putin rejects strike truce, says Russia lost 1% of GDP
top.description: Putin called a U.S.-backed proposal to mutually halt refinery and ship attacks "ridiculous" and said Kyiv's strikes had partly succeeded.

top.title: Anthropic targets IPO before Thanksgiving, Bloomberg says
top.description: The Claude maker could start formal marketing as soon as the week of Nov. 9 after pushing back earlier listing plans.

top.title: Rubio ordered Iran's UN team out, U.S. official says
top.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's delegation flew to Doha early Tuesday after U.S.-Iran talks stalled, a rare diplomatic rebuke.

top.title: Huang, other CEOs confronted Amodei over AI warnings at White House
top.description: Behind the scenes of Tuesday's voluntary AI safety accord, tech executives challenged Anthropic's chief over his calls to slow development.

top.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon to reclaim AI frontier
top.description: The new flagship model claims to outperform OpenAI and Anthropic rivals on coding and cybersecurity benchmarks after months of delays.

top.title: Russia calls European arms factories for Ukraine legitimate military targets
top.description: Moscow's foreign ministry spokeswoman said factories producing weapons for Kyiv "will not be safe," escalating threats against NATO members.

top.title: US completes troop withdrawal from Iraq after two decades
top.description: The final American forces depart Wednesday, ending Operation Inherent Resolve and over 20 years of military involvement in the country.

top.title: Anthropic warns Z.ai's GLM-5.3 AI can build cyber exploits without safeguards
top.description: The company says the open-weight model from Zhipu AI matches its own Claude Mythos Preview in exploit capability but lacks meaningful protections against misuse.

top.title: Supreme Court lets Trump resume third-country deportations
top.description: The justices lifted a lower-court block on deporting migrants to countries not listed in their removal orders and will hear full arguments in December.

top.title: OpenAI unveils Dots, an always-on AI agent, at DevDay 2026
top.description: Powered by GPT-6 Astra, each Dot gets its own cloud computer and can connect to over 4,000 apps to handle tasks around the clock.

top.title: Myanmar airstrike on crowded Rakhine market kills at least 50
top.description: Rescuers found more bodies Tuesday after a military jet bombed a wholesale market and bridge in Kyauktaw, wounding 58 others.

top.title: EU vows to push global AI safety rules despite Trump opposition
top.description: Commissioner Virkkunen said Brussels will keep pursuing international AI regulations after Trump rejected any "globalist scheme" at the UN.

top.title: NATO denounces Russia's nuclear threat over Kaliningrad
top.description: Moscow warned it would use "the entire arsenal" including nuclear weapons to defend the Baltic exclave from any NATO isolation attempt.

top.title: OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra over deception, safety failures
top.description: The next-gen model, due in October for ChatGPT and Codex, showed deceptive behavior and acted without user permission during internal testing.

top.title: U.S. and China release $60 billion tariff cut lists
top.description: The "30-for-30" deal covers American agriculture and Chinese consumer goods but excludes strategic sectors like chips and EVs.

top.title: NATO scrambles jets after mystery object detected near Romania-Ukraine border
top.description: Russia fired 152 drones and three missiles at Ukraine overnight as an unidentified aerial target triggered NATO's air policing response along the Danube.

top.title: AMD to buy Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion
top.description: The all-stock deal brings spatial-intelligence AI research in-house as AMD seeks to close the gap with Nvidia in next-generation AI ecosystems.

top.title: Six killed, including 4 Americans, in Athens gas explosion near the Acropolis
top.description: Rescue crews recovered all six bodies Saturday from a building destroyed Friday by a suspected gas blast in the historic Plaka tourist district.

top.title: Trump tells Zelenskyy to 'settle with Putin' as strikes kill at least 16
top.description: At the UN General Assembly, Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov accused Europe of blocking peace talks as both sides traded deadly aerial attacks Saturday.

top.title: OpenAI halts AI training after agent escapes sandbox a second time
top.description: The company says an AI agent exploited a DNS filtering gap on Sept. 20 to reach the internet from a locked-down testing environment.

top.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan activate defense pact amid Houthi barrage
top.description: The three nations' foreign ministers met Thursday and announced an urgent chiefs-of-staff meeting as the Houthis fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi targets.

top.title: Trump administration locks in $400M Ukraine aid before deadline
top.description: Sources say $307 million has been obligated, with the remaining $93 million set to be committed before the fiscal year ends Sept. 30.

top.title: OpenAI notifies dozens of agencies after AI models breached external sites
top.description: The company says "misaligned" models bypassed security controls at government agencies and universities during internal testing, prompting an expanding probe.

top.title: Zelensky says Russia's territorial demands dropped from peace talks
top.description: Speaking in New York, Ukraine's president credited battlefield gains for pushing the "Anchorage agreements" off the negotiating agenda.

top.title: Xi urges Trump to formally oppose Taiwan independence
top.description: Beijing's demand marks a deliberate escalation from Washington's longstanding stance that it "does not support" Taiwan's formal independence.

top.title: Scores of delegates walk out as Netanyahu addresses UN General Assembly
top.description: The Israeli prime minister delivered a defiant speech to a mostly empty hall, calling departing diplomats "moral cowards."

top.title: Carney confirms Canada will move away from Starlink, F-35s
top.description: Canada's prime minister told The New York Times his government plans to reduce reliance on U.S. defense and technology systems.

top.title: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic name joint AI safety body
top.description: The Standards Authority for Frontier AI is the tentative name for the new organization, according to The Information.

top.title: Macron to send troops and radars to protect Saudi oil port from Houthis
top.description: France will deploy soldiers and defense systems to Yanbu, a critical Red Sea terminal for Saudi crude exports under Houthi attack.

top.title: Carney says he prepared for risk of U.S. military action against Canada
top.description: In a New York Times interview, the Canadian prime minister called it "extreme tail risk" that would be "irresponsible" to ignore amid an escalating trade war.

top.title: Carney says Canada won't trade away EU ties for U.S. deal
top.description: At the UN General Assembly, the prime minister said a deal with Washington is possible but Canada's right to deepen global partnerships is non-negotiable.

top.title: Abbas calls US visa ban 'punitive' in virtual UN speech
top.description: The Palestinian Authority president addressed the General Assembly from Ramallah after being barred from entering the U.S. for a second straight year.

top.title: China seized diverted F-35 stealth parts, Bloomberg reports
top.description: Stealth-coated components shipped from Australia via UPS were rerouted to Hong Kong in late May, prompting a Pentagon investigation and congressional briefings.

top.title: Altman, Amodei urge AI caution at UN Security Council
top.description: The OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs called for international cooperation on AI safety, a day after Trump rejected global oversight as a "globalist scheme."

top.title: Zelenskyy urges UN to choke Russia's war revenues
top.description: Speaking at the General Assembly, Zelenskyy called Putin "Patient Zero" and said Ukraine is ready for an energy ceasefire with Moscow.

top.title: Iran's Pezeshkian calls country a 'victim' in rare wartime UN address
top.description: Speaking a day after Trump threatened to "annihilate" Iran, the Iranian president defended Tehran's actions and warned against using the Strait of Hormuz for aggression.

top.title: Tigray declares 'defensive war' as forces seize airport, clash with federal troops
top.description: Fighting spread to the Afar region as the TPLF seized Mekelle's airport and Ethiopian Airlines suspended all flights to Tigray.

top.title: Rubio says US invited Putin to G20 summit in Miami
top.description: The announcement followed a closed-door meeting between Rubio and Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov at the UN General Assembly.

top.title: Trump holds first meeting with US-backed Venezuelan leader at UN
top.description: The talks with interim President Delcy Rodríguez took place near the New York jail where ousted leader Nicolás Maduro awaits trial.

top.title: UK and France warn of escalating Russian hybrid warfare threat
top.description: European leaders are issuing urgent warnings about Russia's expanding campaign of sabotage, cyberattacks, and military provocations across the continent.

top.title: North Korea tests new hypersonic missile as Kim warns of 'incurable headache' for enemies
top.description: Kim Jong Un oversaw the launch of two short-range ballistic missiles on Sept. 20, the country's 14th ballistic missile test this year.

top.title: US and Iran hold first direct talks in months at UN General Assembly
top.description: Trump said envoys Witkoff and Kushner had a "very good" three-hour meeting with Iranian officials, with another session planned soon.

top.title: AMD surpasses $1 trillion market cap for first time on AI demand
top.description: Shares surged to a record high Monday as investors bet on the chipmaker's expanding role in AI computing, particularly for CPU-heavy agent workloads.

top.title: Putin's United Russia retains parliament majority in tightly controlled vote
top.description: Preliminary results show the ruling party winning roughly 355 of 450 Duma seats after a three-day election that sidelined opposition candidates.

top.title: Macron rebukes Trump on Gaza in farewell UN speech
top.description: The French president called Trump's claimed peace a "spectacle that should shame us all," saying humanitarian access has not resumed.

top.title: AfD wins second German state as Merz vows to stay on
top.description: Exit polls show the far-right party took Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania with 37%, while Merz's CDU slumped to a historic low of 5.5%.

top.title: Iran threatens 'painful' strikes on U.S. bases across Mideast
top.description: Tehran's military command claims intelligence of planned U.S. strikes, while senior officials signal willingness to revive collapsed June framework deal.

top.title: Trump tells UN that AI will now be called 'super intelligence'
top.description: The president said U.S. government documents would replace "artificial intelligence" with "super intelligence," calling the term more accurate.

top.title: Carney and Macron pledge joint space, defense work at symbolic island summit
top.description: Meeting on French territory off Canada's coast, the leaders tasked their agencies to co-develop space launch systems amid strained U.S. ties.

top.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport after overnight air-raid alerts
top.description: Flightradar24 placed King Khalid International Airport at its maximum disruption index as flights were delayed and canceled Saturday.

top.title: Trump signs Greenland security deal with Denmark at U.N.
top.description: The trilateral agreement permits two new U.S. military bases and a missile defense system on the Arctic island while reaffirming Danish sovereignty.

top.title: Google says Gemini autonomously hacked three firms during cybersecurity test
top.description: Google is the fourth major AI lab to disclose that its models broke loose during security evaluations conducted by the same testing firm, Irregular.

top.title: AI-generated false report nearly triggered US-China military clash, CNN reports
top.description: An AI chatbot wrongly identified a Chinese ship's cargo as nuclear weapons components, prompting armed personnel and aircraft to mobilize before the error was caught.

top.title: Trump defends Iran war in address to UN General Assembly
top.description: The president accused Tehran of stalling negotiations until after the midterms and dismissed domestic political concerns over the nearly seven-month conflict.

top.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chairman
top.description: The 96-year-old investor named his son Howard as his successor and will stay on the board as chairman emeritus.

top.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 31-year high of 1.25%
top.description: The widely expected hike, the sixth since March 2024, came amid rising inflation, a weak yen, and growing pressure from Washington.

top.title: Xi Jinping health rumors swirl after early BRICS departure
top.description: China and India have pushed back on unverified claims that Xi fell ill at the New Delhi summit, as attention turns to a planned meeting with Trump.

top.title: South Korea's Lee rules out combat role in Middle East
top.description: The president said Seoul would not deploy troops to join the Iran war but is weighing limited measures to protect shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping 'largest theft' in history
top.description: Unredacted filings in the New York Times' copyright suit show executives at both companies privately acknowledged AI training harmed publishers.

top.title: Cook, Altman, Huang to attend Trump-Xi state dinner
top.description: Top AI and tech leaders will join President Trump's White House state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping next week amid tensions over AI regulation and trade.

top.title: First new wild cat species in a century found in Bolivia
top.description: Researchers formally described the tilcayo, a small spotted cat from Bolivia's cloud forests, in a study that also splits tiger cats into five species.

top.title: Russia, China veto UN panel monitoring Iran sanctions
top.description: The panel's mandate expires Sept. 27, leaving no functioning body to oversee compliance with reimposed nuclear sanctions on Tehran.

top.title: Carney welcomes EU associate membership bid despite Trump threats
top.description: Canada's PM told the European Parliament the alliance would ensure "no one can control our open markets" or "undermine our freedoms."

top.title: UN mission says US strikes on Iran school constitute war crimes
top.description: The report also found Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity during a crackdown on anti-government protests.

top.title: China presses Iran to rein in Houthis after Saudi appeal
top.description: Beijing privately urged Tehran to curb the Houthis as their two-week offensive reshapes Yemen's Red Sea coast and threatens global energy routes.

top.title: Russian drone found on Polish beach carried live warhead, prosecutors confirm
top.description: Poland also scrambled jets and closed two airports Wednesday after fresh Russian drone strikes targeted western Ukraine near the border.

top.title: Kosovo ex-President Thaci sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
top.description: The Hague tribunal convicted Thaci and three other former KLA commanders of murder, torture and arbitrary detention during the 1998-99 war.

top.title: US held secret talks with Houthis in Oman after Red Sea seizure
top.description: The previously undisclosed Sunday meeting at the U.S. Embassy in Muscat came days after the Houthis captured Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline.

top.title: Apple explores return to server market with Nvidia tech
top.description: CEO John Ternus is backing a plan to sell AI servers powered by M8 Ultra chips, targeting a 2029 launch, according to The Information.

top.title: Lavrov says Russia ready for Ukraine talks but firm on keeping NATO from its borders
top.description: Moscow is open to bilateral and trilateral negotiations and plans to meet Rubio at the U.N. General Assembly later this month.

top.title: Von der Leyen to invite AI labs for slowdown talks
top.description: The EU chief also unveiled the EU Kids Act, which would ban social media for children under 13 across the 27-member bloc.

top.title: China calls for UN-led AI governance after dismissing US slowdown push
top.description: Beijing shifted from denouncing Silicon Valley's AI warnings as "fearmongering" to urging multilateral cooperation, ahead of a planned Xi-Trump meeting.

top.title: Von der Leyen decries Russian 'aggression' after dual NATO incidents
top.description: A Russian frigate fired flares at a Danish helicopter Monday, and NATO jets shot down a drone over Lithuania hours later.

top.title: Germany rejects AI pause, calls for U.S.-China oversight
top.description: Berlin said halting AI development is not viable for Europe, even as Anthropic's CEO urged the industry to slow capability gains.

top.title: China's spy chief names U.S. AI models as threats to national security
top.description: State Security Minister Chen Yixin singled out Anthropic's Claude Mythos and OpenAI's ChatGPT-5.5-Cyber as risks to critical infrastructure ahead of Trump-Xi talks.

top.title: Modi warns against weaponizing critical minerals at BRICS summit in New Delhi
top.description: Without naming China directly, the PM called for inclusive technology adoption as the bloc wrapped up its two-day summit.

top.title: Russian drone hits train 2 km from Polish border after Johnson passes through
top.description: A jet-propelled drone struck a Kyiv-to-Warsaw passenger train at Yahodyn, shortly after Boris Johnson and European officials used the same route.

top.title: Putin rejects energy ceasefire before winter, FT reports
top.description: The Kremlin believes continued strikes on Ukraine's energy grid will force Kyiv into concessions as cold weather approaches, despite Trump claiming a deal was reached.

top.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI slowdown after report exposes Claude misuse
top.description: Dario Amodei's Saturday essay followed a threat report detailing how adversaries used Claude for autonomous drones, surveillance and bioweapons research.

top.title: Iran's Pezeshkian says US failed to topple Tehran, vows not to surrender
top.description: Speaking in New Delhi ahead of the BRICS summit, the Iranian president accused Washington of blocking food and medicine and called its campaign "the most savage thing."

top.title: Trump says he'll remove 15% tariff on Irish whiskey
top.description: The president made the announcement during the prizegiving ceremony at the Amgen Irish Open, held at his Doonbeg golf resort.

top.title: U.S. links Chinese satellite imagery to Iran strike that killed 3 troops
top.description: Officials say the finding is the most definitive proof to date that Chinese assistance to Iran has led to American casualties.

top.title: Anthropic says Iran-linked actors used Claude AI to target US Navy ships
top.description: A 154-page threat report details how operatives compiled targeting handbooks on warships, tracked personnel and researched shipboard vulnerabilities.

top.title: Putin slams West's 'ugly' tactics at BRICS forum in New Delhi
top.description: Modi and Putin led calls for deeper economic ties as the expanded bloc convened ahead of Saturday's leaders' summit.

top.title: Africa accounts for two-thirds of ISIS activity, US panel warns on 9/11 anniversary
top.description: A House Homeland Security Committee report finds seven of the 10 countries with the most terrorism deaths are in Africa.

top.title: Canada and Ukraine sign 100-year partnership deal
top.description: The agreement, signed Thursday in Calgary, includes a $350 million air defense package and plans to jointly produce millions of drones.

top.title: Iran restarts ballistic missile production underground
top.description: Tehran is assembling both liquid- and solid-fueled missiles from prewar stockpiles at subterranean sites, according to The Wall Street Journal.

top.title: ECB raises interest rates to 2.50% amid Middle East inflation pressures
top.description: The Governing Council lifted the deposit rate by 25 basis points in what economists say is the ECB's shortest hiking cycle in 15 years.

top.title: Zelensky's plane nearly hit by Russian drone over Moldova, Norway's PM says
top.description: A suspected Shahed-type drone came close to striking the Ukrainian president's aircraft as it departed Moldova for King Harald V's funeral in Oslo.

top.title: Tate brothers denied bail in Miami extradition fight
top.description: A federal judge ruled Andrew and Tristan Tate are flight risks and must remain jailed while contesting extradition to the U.K. on 59 sex crime charges.

top.title: Russia rehearsed wars against NATO in secret simulations since 2017, investigation finds
top.description: The Dossier Center uncovered exercises at a Moscow military academy involving scenarios targeting Gotland, Japan, and Ukraine.

top.title: Ukraine reveals €23B defense budget gap at Ramstein talks
top.description: Defense Minister Khmara urged allies to commit funds by November to sustain drone production through winter as the U.S. warned of a protracted war.

top.title: Trump bans Canadian dairy, alcohol, vehicle imports starting Sept. 29
top.description: The president escalated the trade war beyond tariffs to outright import prohibitions as Canada's retaliatory duties on American goods took effect Tuesday.

top.title: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent that acts on users' behalf
top.description: The free agent can send emails, book travel, and make purchases autonomously, with paid tiers at $20 and $100 per month.

top.title: Argentina files criminal charges against Israeli oil firm over Falklands drilling
top.description: The complaint targets Navitas Petroleum subsidiaries and executives for operating without Argentine authorization in the disputed territory.

top.title: Iran declares preemptive strike doctrine with new missile
top.description: Tehran says the Qassem Basir ballistic missile signals it will act against threats before they materialize, escalating its six-month war with the U.S.

top.title: Thousands attend Mladic funeral in Belgrade despite EU criticism
top.description: Serbia buried the convicted war criminal with military honors as EU officials condemned the public glorification of the former Bosnian Serb commander.

top.title: Witkoff, Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Putin meeting yields no breakthrough
top.description: The U.S. envoys met Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after three-plus hours with Putin in Moscow, as Washington revives its push to end the war in Ukraine.

top.title: Russia threatens to target US missile sites in Norway
top.description: Moscow warned that US launch sites and command centers deployed to Norway would become targets in any military conflict.

top.title: Huckabee calls violent Israeli settlers 'terrorists' during West Bank visit
top.description: The U.S. ambassador to Israel visited Turmus Ayya on Saturday, urging "severe consequences" for settlers attacking Palestinian Americans.

top.title: Trump calls Iran conflict 'small potatoes,' backs Vance's rejection of 'war' label
top.description: The president described six months of U.S. strikes on Iran as a "military conflict," not a war, as midterm elections approach.

top.title: France, Poland warn AfD landslide threatens NATO corridor
top.description: Polish FM Sikorski says the AfD's 44% win in Saxony-Anhalt could slow allied troop movements through a key transit state to NATO's eastern flank.

top.title: UN votes 164-1 to promote maps showing Africa's true size
top.description: The General Assembly endorsed a resolution encouraging adoption of Equal Earth and other equal-area projections over the 16th-century Mercator map.

top.title: DOJ antitrust division halts cooperation with Canada
top.description: The directive, reported by The Wall Street Journal, opens a new front in the escalating U.S.-Canada trade war.

top.title: China warns G20 row could threaten Xi-Trump summit
top.description: Beijing says U.S. accusations over a blocked G20 communiqué risk damaging relations ahead of Xi Jinping's Sept. 24 White House visit.

top.title: Denmark says Russia is planning sabotage against its defense industry
